description: This Java source file defines a collection of classes related to temporal expressions, including various concrete implementations such as date ranges, day in month, hour ranges, frequency, and set operations like union and intersection. It provides mechanisms to evaluate, compare, and manipulate temporal expressions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions
classes.description: A collection of classes for representing and evaluating complex temporal expressions, including ranges, set operations, and timing patterns.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: Represents a range of dates, providing methods to check if a date falls within the range, and to get the first date in the range.

classes.name: DayInMonth
classes.description: Represents a specific occurrence of a weekday in a month (like the 2nd Tuesday).

classes.name: DayOfMonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days within a month.

classes.name: DayOfWeekRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days within a week.

classes.name: Difference
classes.description: Represents a set difference between two temporal expressions.

classes.name: Frequency
classes.description: Represents a repeating frequency of an event starting from a specific date.

classes.name: HourRange
classes.description: Represents a range of hours within a day.

classes.name: MonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of months within a year.

classes.name: Null
classes.description: A null implementation of TemporalExpression, representing no date.

classes.name: Substitution
classes.description: Provides a substitution for an excluded temporal expression.

classes.name: Union
classes.description: Represents a union of multiple temporal expressions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process the temporal expression.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this expression is equal to another.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first date matching the expression from the given calendar.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Determines whether a given calendar date is included.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a date is a candidate for substitution.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next occurrence after the provided calendar and context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the expression.
